name: Stun FX
description: Client-side mace PvP effects. A Jujutsu Kaisen style Black Flash on stunslams (shield break followed by a hit within 0.7 seconds), a stunslam combo counter, shockwave rings on mace hits, totem pop and kill effects, a totem pop counter and an Unstable SMP style death sound. Compact in-game settings (Right Shift or /stunfx) with five looks, colours, sizes and drag-and-drop HUD positions.
